title: OOMKilled after traffic increase
symptoms: Container restarted with OOMKilled after traffic increase
root_cause: Memory limit may be too low or application memory usage increased
fix: Review memory metrics and profile the application; adjust resources only after review

title: ImagePullBackOff
symptoms: Kubernetes pod cannot pull container image
root_cause: Image tag, registry permissions, or image-pull secret may be incorrect
fix: Verify image name/tag and registry access; do not expose registry credentials

title: Dependency build failure
symptoms: ModuleNotFoundError or npm ERR during CI build
root_cause: Dependency absent, lockfile mismatch, or build environment drift
fix: Reconcile manifests and lockfiles and run tests in a clean build environment

title: Connection refused
symptoms: Application cannot connect to a downstream service
root_cause: Target service may be down or endpoint/port/network configuration may be wrong
fix: Check service health, DNS, port, network policies, and recent changes
